review.title: Daily review
settings.defaultHour.desc: For a date without a time. Example: "tomorrow" is due tomorrow at %1. If that time has already passed today, "today" uses the next full hour.
settings.groupTasks.desc: On: Tasks shows Today, Upcoming and No due date. Off: one list, ordered by due date.
settings.hideTitles.desc: Reminders say "Task due" instead of the title, and the daily review gives counts only. Useful when sharing your screen.
settings.invalid: Not recognised. Use the format shown; the previous value is kept.
settings.keepArchivedDays.desc: Archived tasks are deleted permanently after this many days. 0 keeps them.
settings.keepDoneDays.desc: Completed tasks move from Completed to Archived after this many days. 0 keeps them in Completed.
settings.nagEveryMin.desc: How often an overdue task reminds you again, until you complete or reschedule it. Example: due at 09:00, reminders at %1 and so on.
settings.quietHours.desc: No reminders in this window; held reminders are sent when it ends. Format HH:MM-HH:MM. Leave empty for none.
settings.remindAheadMin.desc: An extra reminder this long before a task is due, in addition to the one when it is due. Example: due at 09:00, reminders at %1. If a task is due sooner than this, only the due reminder is sent. 0 turns this off.
settings.reviewTime.desc: Once a day, a summary of open tasks, including tasks with no due date, which never send reminders. Format HH:MM. Leave empty to turn it off.
settings.showCount: Show count on the bar icon
settings.showCount.desc: The number of overdue tasks, or of tasks due today when none are overdue.
settings.snoozeMin.desc: Snoozing stops all reminders and the daily review until it ends. Used by the snooze button on reminders, s in the task list, and "Remind in" on the daily review.
settings.title: Settings
widget.unavailable: The Overdue service is not running
